implementation: Optional resource_ledger defaults to None and preserves legacy external supplied-baseline accounting contract.

Shared path uses the same actual ledger for proposer, checked proposal/config copies, validation, planner/source revalidation, clean rerun and paid raw_snapshot read. Global work and absolute deadline never reset.
Each rerun runs under a local lower work/time/memory scope; setup resolution and paid terminal raw_snapshot stay inside the scope. Actual shared ledger is forwarded to AnalysisSession.from_snapshot.

Adoption reads status and coverage from the actual returned snapshot, with fallback proposed policy identity when a bounded terminal controller omits policy_digest. Truncated results cannot replace a usable baseline.
Shared failure reports actual charged work, without inventing full-window work. Baseline work uses the actual ledger entry total instead of untrusted baseline counters.
Quality copies/scans are admitted and cached so denied setup does not perform a later unpaid large scan. Proposer receives isolated JSON DTO copies of baseline and config.
Outer Session owns final feedback total/scope refresh before paid publication. LLM query-quality selection, provider transports and credentials are unchanged.

original_before.failure: Existing L1 total-work report did not match shared outer-session accounting.

new_controls: same actual ledger ignores forged baseline cost
rejected validation has paid fees without starting rerun
child max_work=1 does not refresh global budget
post-work rerun failure does not charge an invented full window
actual bounded returned snapshot controls adoption
zero outer work scope prevents proposer callback
sampled lower memory cap denies before child execution
proposer mutation cannot alter trusted baseline or policy
post-proposal checkpoint retains original absolute deadline
tests.preserved_original_limits: Existing max_work=2000 and lowered child max_work=1 assertions unchanged.
tests.test_setup_correction: One initial authored fixture omitted required actual_engine; corrected before held green runs. This is a test-only setup correction, not production red-to-green credit.

limits: Tests use offline/synthetic proposers and deterministic fake clock/memory observations where indicated; no live vendor request or credential access.
Logical work is a versioned software budget, not physical CPU preemption. Arbitrary synchronous proposer callbacks are admitted before invocation and checked for deadline after return.
Legacy None baseline accounting preserves externally supplied reported historical totals; it does not retroactively measure prior work.
Independent final source binding, whole-candidate gates and task closure remain root-owned. SEM production remained held and unchanged during this task.

final_planner_port.reason: Budget shared build_plan now requires resolved EffectiveConfig to prevent legacy unmetered configuration thaw/resolution.
final_planner_port.change: Shared validate resolves already-shape-admitted updated config then passes same ledger to build_plan; legacy None call unchanged.
final_planner_port.tests: 42 original+author controls pass in2.54s; independent consumer CPU20 pass, no caps/assertion edits.
